from datetime import datetime
now = datetime.now()
print('now', now, now.year, now.month)

# Fetch supervisor cards
sup_cards = apis.supervisor.show_payment_cards()
print('supervisor cards count', len(sup_cards))

# Determine expired (expiry month/year <= current month/year)
expired = []
for c in sup_cards:
    exp_y = int(c['expiry_year'])
    exp_m = int(c['expiry_month'])
    is_expired = (exp_y < now.year) or (exp_y == now.year and exp_m <= now.month)
    if is_expired:
        expired.append(c)

expired_numbers = set(int(round(c['card_number'])) for c in expired)
print('expired cards count', len(expired))
print('expired card_numbers', sorted(expired_numbers))

# Check which apps have show_payment_cards
apps = ['amazon','venmo','spotify','splitwise','todoist','simple_note','file_system','gmail','phone','supervisor']
apps_with_cards = []
for app in apps:
    descs = apis.api_docs.show_api_descriptions(app_name=app)
    has = any(d.get('name')=='show_payment_cards' for d in descs)
    if has:
        apps_with_cards.append(app)
print('apps_with_show_payment_cards', apps_with_cards)

print('available app passwords', sorted(pw_map.keys()))

apps = ['amazon','venmo','spotify']
expired_ids_by_app = {}
expired_cards_by_app = {}
access_tokens = {}

for app in apps:
    if app not in pw_map:
        print('skip', app, 'no password')
        continue
    pw = pw_map[app]
    # login exactly once
    login_resp = getattr(apis, app).login(username=email, password=pw)
    access_token = login_resp.get('access_token')
    access_tokens[app] = access_token
    print('\n==', app, '==')
    print('access_token set', bool(access_token))

    cards = getattr(apis, app).show_payment_cards(access_token=access_token)
    print('payment_cards_count', len(cards))

    expired_cards = []
    for c in cards:
        exp_y = int(c['expiry_year'])
        exp_m = int(c['expiry_month'])
        is_expired = (exp_y < now_year) or (exp_y == now_year and exp_m <= now_month)
        if is_expired:
            expired_cards.append(c)

    expired_cards_by_app[app] = expired_cards
